title: Co-organising the first InterAI workshop at IEEE RO-MAN 2024
excerpt: Dr Di Fu co-organised the first InterAI: Interactive AI for Human-Centred Robotics workshop at IEEE RO-MAN 2024 in Pasadena, USA. The workshop explored interactive AI approaches to human-robot interaction and collaboration.

provenance.dateEvidence: Official workshop homepage: 26 August 2024, Pasadena, CA, USA. Organiser and Surrey biography confirm Di Fu's co-organiser role. This settled event date takes precedence over the older CFP's tentative August 26 or 30 venue wording; June 30 was a submission deadline, not a posting date.

titleZh: 共同组织 IEEE RO-MAN 2024 首届 InterAI 研讨会
excerptZh: Di Fu 博士共同组织了在美国帕萨迪纳举行的 IEEE RO-MAN 2024 首届 InterAI: Interactive AI for Human-Centred Robotics workshop。研讨会探讨了用于人机交互与协作的交互式人工智能方法。
